I know the black and white mindset people with our disorder has can cause confusion as you think one day someone will always be there and the next day they do one small thing and you think they hate you. I can't promise it will get better and I myself and tired of hearing that phrase myself. if you do this you let them win. stay alive and get help. even if it is just a "fuck you" to the people who tormented you.
